experiment_plans.feasibility_notes: Method is straightforward; the data is the obstacle, since the named source is not openly available.
experiment_plans.objective: Test whether length of stay predicts 30-day readmission independently of admission diagnosis.
experiment_plans.design: Retrospective observational analysis with diagnosis as a covariate.

data_requirements.description: Patient-level admission records including length of stay, primary diagnosis, and readmission within 30 days.
preprocessing_steps: Group rare diagnoses into an other category

methods.name: multivariable logistic regression
methods.description: Readmission regressed on length of stay adjusted for diagnosis group.

evaluation.baseline: A model using admission diagnosis alone.
evaluation.success_criteria: Length of stay remains associated with readmission after adjustment, improving AUC by at least 0.02.

implementation_steps.description: Add length of stay and refit

risks: MIMIC requires credentialing, so the real cohort may not be obtainable here.

priority_order.justification: the only plan in this benchmark case
